name: SentinelSQL Enterprise Domain Text-to-SQL Validation Suite

queries.question: Show customers in the North region
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_id, name, email FROM customers WHERE region = 'North' LIMIT 100;

queries.question: Show customers in the West region
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_id, name, email FROM customers WHERE region = 'West' LIMIT 100;

queries.question: Count the total number of products in stock
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as product_count FROM products LIMIT 100;

queries.question: Show orders placed after January 10th 2025
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT order_id, order_date, amount FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-10' LIMIT 100;

queries.question: Find products in the Electronics category
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT product_id, name, price FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics' LIMIT 100;

queries.question: What is the total spending per customer?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) as total_spent FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id LIMIT 100;

queries.question: Show customer names alongside their order amounts
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.name, o.amount FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LIMIT 100;

queries.question: Find total order sales revenue by region
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.region, SUM(o.amount) as regional_sales FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.region LIMIT 100;

queries.question: Count the number of orders placed in each region
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.region LIMIT 100;

queries.question: Calculate the average product price in each category
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT category, AVG(price) as avg_price FROM products GROUP BY category LIMIT 100;

queries.question: What is our Average Order Value (AOV)?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT AVG(amount) as aov FROM orders LIMIT 100;

queries.question: Identify VIP Customers who have spent 1000 or more in cumulative orders
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) as total_spent FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING SUM(amount) >= 1000 LIMIT 100;

queries.question: Find customers who placed orders above the average order amount
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.amount > (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM orders) LIMIT 100;

queries.question: Calculate highest order amount and lowest order amount by region
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.region, MAX(o.amount) as max_amt, MIN(o.amount) as min_amt FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.region LIMIT 100;

queries.question: Find regions where total order revenue exceeds 3000 dollars
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.region, SUM(o.amount) as total_rev FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.region HAVING SUM(o.amount) > 3000 LIMIT 100;
